verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API and dashboard platform, so a privacy control such as opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. It covers sandbox, authentication, webhooks, payments, and stablecoin docs, none of which concern this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
